dedupe_keys.name: places de parking et parkings du pays ajaccien

description: Places de parking et parkings du Pays Ajaccien is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CAPA-Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays Ajaccien. Géolocalisation de l’emplacement des places de parking de surface et des parkings du Pays Ajaccien. Il s’agit de la liste de tous les parkings et de toutes les places de surface délimitées, qu’elles soient payantes, gratuites, réservées aux personnes à mobilité réduite ou à durée limitée (exemple: places « 20 minutes », places « livraison ... Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are parking, voirie. The portal shows 211 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
